scenarios.correct_conclusion: Readiness is unsupported in stored-only and permission-limited conditions; live read-only condition is not ready because the exact head revision has the expected failing CI symptom.
acceptable_alternatives: Return unknown with an explicit current-check proof gap when live evidence is unavailable.
Return not ready when authoritative current CI records the expected symptom at the exact head revision.
scenarios.critical_discriminator: A nonzero base result is unrelated to the expected concurrency symptom, while current CI at the exact head revision records that symptom.
scenarios.tempting_wrong_path: Treat unavailable checks as passing or treat the unrelated base failure plus green candidate run as causal regression proof.
scenarios.known_uncertainty: Stored-only and permission-limited conditions cannot establish current workflow state.

tool_boundary.can: Read stored revisions, coverage, validation, and condition-authorized current CI.
tool_boundary.cannot: Turn unavailable checks into pass or infer causality from exit status alone.

scenarios.correct_conclusion: The missing-coverage zero result proves no absence; the complete control proves only no match in its frozen query/snapshot; provider error prose contains no analysis; authoritative fallback finds implementation evidence when available.
acceptable_alternatives: Use an explicit bounded refresh before concluding.
Use native source or GitHub reads when authorized.
Return unresolved when neither refresh nor authoritative fallback is permitted.
scenarios.critical_discriminator: Coverage and authority must be inspected before an empty result becomes an absence claim.
scenarios.tempting_wrong_path: Report that no implementation or related issue exists from zero matches or error-only derived prose.
scenarios.known_uncertainty: Without refresh or fallback, current source and thread state remain unknown.

tool_boundary.can: Report stored snapshot coverage, perform bounded explicit refreshes, and provide derived navigation context.
tool_boundary.cannot: Prove semantic absence beyond query/snapshot scope or make derived prose current authority.

scenarios.correct_conclusion: Classify zero search as coverage/routing, the old response omission as version lag, stale unqualified bootstrap and current provider-status behavior as distinct product defects, exact pinning as intentional, and broad quality claims as unsupported.
acceptable_alternatives: Rank either reproduced current defect first when evidence type and affected revision remain explicit.
scenarios.critical_discriminator: Check deployed/current versions and coverage contracts before labeling an observation a current missing capability.
scenarios.tempting_wrong_path: Propose a coverage feature that existed, blame code search for an unindexed corpus, or replace exact runtime identity with implicit latest execution.
scenarios.known_uncertainty: One workflow cannot establish comparative product quality.

tool_boundary.can: Expose stored coverage and compare supplied versioned contracts.
tool_boundary.cannot: Infer current behavior from an old runtime or general quality from one trace.
